response.description: Preserve Self-EvolveRec’s diagnostic interface while adapting its probes to the corrected BERT4Rec backbone. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns measured metrics and metric_definitions; diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis) explains those results using their definitions.
response.motivation: Make model diagnosis useful for architecture refinement without assuming unavailable review data or simulator traits. Compare changes using macro-average validation HR@10 across all four datasets.
response.implementation_notes: Preserve the host ModelView interfaces and inspect the actual trained view.model. Support batches shaped B × L containing (None, sequence, positive, negative). Respect left padding, reserved mask tokens, masked-target training and appended-mask inference; never expose the prediction target through bidirectional input. Use only observed histories, titles, descriptions and timestamps. Treat diversity/conformity traits as unobserved. Maintain one independently trained checkpoint per category and keep the embedded predictor consistent with its architecture. The simulator receives full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty training users, five per category.
response.pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        disable gradients
        for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
            apply BERT4Rec-compatible masking and padding rules
            compute supported diagnostic measurements through ModelView
            aggregate measurements with explicit valid counts
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: aggregated measurements,
                metric_definitions: definitions and availability limits}

function diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    identify unavailable evidence explicitly
    request evidence-grounded interpretations and testable hypotheses
    prohibit invented attributes and independent-model fusion

originality.positive: Connects a stable diagnostic interface to family-specific model behavior and explicit evidence limits.
originality.negative: Primarily an adaptation contract; it does not specify a new diagnostic algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Could support reproducible diagnosis-driven refinement across sequential architectures.
future_potential.negative: Value depends on choosing reliable probes and demonstrating validation improvements; no results are supplied.

code_difficulty.positive: The fixed interfaces and batch structure make the integration scope clear.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, left-padding handling, metric aggregation and checkpoint–predictor consistency require careful implementation.
